Talent0_2Ability.name: Complete Calculation
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: After actively attacking with Rocket Launchers, applies <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=4012502>[Structural Damage]</buf> to the target hit, up to <color=#F74848>10</color> stakcs. Rocket Launchers weight reduced by <color=#F74848>-130</color>.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Complete Calculation
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
After actively attacking with Rocket Launchers, applies <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=4012502>[Structural Damage]</buf> to the target hit, up to <color=#F74848>12</color> stakcs. Rocket Launchers weight reduced by <color=#F74848>-130</color>.
When actively attacking targets carrying <buf ID=4012502>[Structural Damage]</buf>, DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

400001.name: Strategic Bombing 1
400001.SpecificEffects: When a Tactical Weapon runs out of ammo, trigger <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf>. This process takes <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

700015.name: Rotation
700015.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if no damage was dealt this turn, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

401203.name: Overload
401203.describe: Fully reloads Rocket Launchers ammo and gains <buf ID=7100403>[Crit Rate UP II]</buf>, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn. Can continue to act with remaining movement.

401204.name: System Override
401204.describe: Choose either <skill activeSkill=4012041>[Command Override]</skill> or <skill activeSkill=4012042>[Weapon Override]</skill> to use

401205.name: Real-Time Analysis
401205.SpecificEffects: When actively attacked, DMG taken reduces by <color=#F74848>10%</color>, applies <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=4012502>[Structural Damage]</buf> to the attacker. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

401206.name: Disintegration Strike
401206.describe: Consumes <color=#F74848>2</color> Rocket Ammo, attacks all enemies within <range type=1>5x5</range> area, dealing <color=#F74848>0.25x</color> AoE DMG to all parts of the targets hit. Critical Hit chance increases by <color=#F74848>25%</color> for this attack.

401207.name: Chain Reaction
401207.SpecificEffects: After an enemy takes action, if they are carrying <buf ID=4012502>[Structural Damage]</buf>, applies <color=#F74848>1</color> additional stack of <buf ID=4012502>[Structural Damage]</buf> to that enemy.

401208.name: Annihilation Beacon
401208.describe: Marks a <range type=1>5×5</range> area as [Annihilation Zone]. Switches to <skill activeSkill=4012082>[Final Barrage]</skill> after use. This skill cannot be used again after switching in current turn. Can only be used with <color=#F74848>2</color> Rocket Launchers equipped.

400031.name: Indiscriminate 1
400031.SpecificEffects: After the first attack with a Tactical Weapon each turn, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, with Final DMG <color=#F74848>-30%</color>, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

400033.name: Strategic Bombing 4
400033.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf> is complete, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

400034.name: Indiscriminate 2
400034.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Tactical Weapon for the first time each turn, for every <color=#F74848>1</color> AP cost, DMG <color=#F74848>+4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

400035.name: Indiscriminate 3
400035.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> is triggered, allow continued moving with the remaining movement.

400036.name: Indiscriminate 4
400036.SpecificEffects: After triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, it no longer reduces final damage.

401241.name: Controlled Variable 1
401241.SpecificEffects: When an enemy carrying <buf ID=4012502>[Structural Damage]</buf> is destroyed, transfers all stacks of <buf ID=4012502>[Structural Damage]</buf> to another enemy with highest HP within <color=#F74848>3</color> adjacent tiles.

400043.name: Power Innovation 3
400043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

401244.name: Controlled Variable 2
401244.SpecificEffects: DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>15%</color> when actively attacking with Rocket Launchers. DMG dealt additionally increases by <color=#F74848>100%</color> when attacking Titans.

401245.name: Controlled Variable 3
401245.SpecificEffects: When an enemy carrying <color=#F74848>5</color> or more stacks <buf ID=4012502>[Structural Damage]</buf> is destroyed, recovers <color=#F74848>1</color> AP. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

401246.name: Controlled Variable 4
401246.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=4012502>[Structural Damage]</buf> causes <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf>, for each <color=#F74848>1</color> critical hit scored by the Rocket Launcher attack, <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> will deal <color=#F74848>1</color> additional instance of DMG, up to color=#F74848>3</color> additional instances.

hiddenSkills.name: Pulse Wave
hiddenSkills.describe: Uses a Rocket Launcher to attack all targets within a <range type=1>1-tile cross-shaped</range> area, dealing <color=#F74848>0.25x</color> AoE DMG to all parts of targets hit. This attack always triggers <buf ID=4012502>[Structural Damage]</buf> <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf>. For each <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=4012502>[Structural Damage]</buf>, applies <color=#F74848>1</color> more instance of <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf>, up to <color=#F74848>1</color> times. Removes all <buf ID=4012502>[Structural Damage]</buf> stacks from the target after triggering.
